tools.name: search_documentation
tools.description: Search SWG bar's published documentation in one of its 12 website languages. Returns source links and excerpts; cannot inspect a Mac or private data.

tools.name: get_documentation
tools.description: Read a published SWG bar page as Markdown. Use a canonical page path returned by search_documentation, such as /en/install/. Only published public pages are available.

tools.name: get_latest_release
tools.description: Get the current SWG bar installer version, download URL and SHA-256 checksum from the published release manifest.

tools.name: get_product_catalog
tools.description: Read SWG bar Personal and Team license prices, supported quantities and browser purchase links. Does not create an order, charge payment or access a license.
